Both partners’ claims history also counts towards the premium, so making a claim for a minor accident today would likely raise the rate for many years ahead. Policy updates and any new government guidance on mental health inclusivity typically trickle down automatically through insurers' annual benefit updates, so monitoring detailed policy changes yourself is unnecessary. Enrolling through a state marketplace further safeguards against lapses in mental health benefits, as states maintain their own oversight ensuring all existing ACA protections are enforced.
